title: ContextBenchQuestion
description: Versioned machine-readable benchmark question. Ground truth lives outside production code; adapters must not inspect expected_* at query time.

category.description: definition: symbol impl; caller: who calls; callee: what does X call; test: related tests; conceptual: how is X implemented; exact: identifier/path literal

query.description: Natural language query as a user would ask

expected_files.description: Relative POSIX paths from repo root that should appear in results (at least one)

expected_symbols.description: Optional symbol names that should appear (for definition/caller/callee)

notes.description: Human notes on why this ground truth is correct and how to verify

ground_truth_source.description: How ground truth was established; must be independently verifiable

language.description: Primary language of expected file (redundant with manifest, for filter)
